chunks: And from him (Al-Hurr al-Amili) from Al-Nawfali from As-Sakuni from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said: 'The best of intercessions is that you intercede between two people in marriage until Allah unites them.'
ai.seo_question: What is considered the best form of intercession in Shia tradition?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) attributes to Imam Ali (AS) the distinction that matchmaking is the supreme form of intercession, elevating the social act of facilitating marriage to a spiritual merit. This highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on *tazwij* not merely as a legal contract but as a communal duty that fosters social cohesion and divine blessing, encouraging believers to actively bridge gaps between compatible partners.
